mechanics.claim: Vault knocks the target back a short distance, interrupting uncancellable attack windups, and resets Quinn's attack timer shortly after the dash, after which she automatically attacks the target.
mechanics.quote: ''Vault'' {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' remaining attack cooldown a short delay after the first dash ends (even if interrupted).

mechanics.claim: Quinn will automatically attempt to attack the target once she completes Vault.
mechanics.quote: '''Quinn''' will automatically attempt to attack the target once she completes ''Vault''.

mechanics.claim: Vault's knockback interrupts uncancellable attack windups.
mechanics.quote: ''Vault's'' {{tip|airborne|knock back}} also interrupts the windup of basic attacks with {{tip|uncancellable windup|uncancellable windups}}.
